title: 第44章 香獐子初现

第44章 香獐子初现-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

“山哥，这距离有点远吧？”赵红旗望着小溪中的水獭，开口道。

确实。

小溪中的水獭距离李青山确实有些远，大概有五十多米的距离，这个距离刚好是自己手中这把长弓的力量衰弱距离，精准度也下降严重。

不过，这是对别的猎人而言。

对于李青山而言，影响倒是并不大，不过为了以防万一，李青山还是决定再靠近一些。

毕竟这玩意的价值，可比刚刚打的獐子价值要高多了。

一张皮可就是三十多块钱啊！

这个年代要是有洗脚的话，估计足浴洗脚一条龙一次才一块钱，这一张皮能连续去一个月的。

李青山的脚步很轻，然而水獭的警觉性却更高，还没推进七八米，这水獭便发现了情况，停下啃食鲫鱼的动作，抬头朝着李青山的方向张望过来。

现在的距离是四十多米。

但是水獭明显已经发现自己了，只有一次机会，要是不中，这水獭潜入小溪中游动，就完全没了机会。

这一刻。

身后的二壮和赵红旗双拳紧握，拳心甚至渗出了汗液，紧张的望着眼前这一幕。

“嗖！”

李青山的猎弓满月，长箭瞬间射了出去，速度极快，这水獭只是看到一道黑影朝着自己飞射而来，刚刚反应过来准备逃跑，便感觉眼前一黑，长箭没入头部和脖子的位置。

殷红的鲜血很快染红了溪水，肥硕的身体不断在小溪中挣扎，大黄率先冲了出去，紧接着便是李青山，从水中将水獭提出来的时候，就已经不怎么动弹了。

“刀！”

李青山话音落下，二壮立刻将手中柴刀给李青山递了过去。

“水獭皮比较珍贵，可以说这一身的肉还没有这半张皮贵，以后要是再打到水獭处理皮草的时候，一定要谨慎一些，比如说这刀就不能用太过于锋利的，一定要用钝刀，因为太锋利的刀会伤到皮毛，一旦不小心戳个洞，那价格就能直接给你压个四分之一，甚至三分之一。”

“还有，抓到的水獭一定要尽快控血，也不要让血液沾染皮草上面，宛然皮草，要拎着这东西的后腿开刀，四只爪子的皮毛甚至包括脑袋上的皮毛都要保留，虽然说后期制作的时候，脑袋上这些皮草是不用的，但要保存好。”

李青山一边说着，一边手中柴刀小心翼翼的处理着，时不时发出柴刀划过皮肉的时沙沙的声响。

刚死的水獭还有一些温度，不过这水獭十分肥硕，说明这条小溪渔获资源不错，脂肪极其粘稠滑腻，李青山小心的将其分离着。

赵红旗和二壮在一旁看着直点头。

"Brother Shan, isn't this a bit far away?" Zhao Hongqi looked at the otter in the stream and said.

really.

The otter in the stream is indeed quite far away from Li Qingshan, about fifty meters away. This distance is exactly the distance at which the power of the longbow in his hand weakens, and the accuracy also drops seriously.

However, this is for other hunters.

For Li Qingshan, the impact was not big, but just in case, Li Qingshan decided to get closer.

After all, the value of this thing is much higher than the value of the deer just shot.

A piece of skin costs more than thirty yuan!

If there were foot baths in this era, it would probably only cost one yuan a time for a foot bath, and this piece of skin could last for a month.

Li Qingshan's steps were very light, but the otter was more alert. Before he advanced seven or eight meters, the otter noticed the situation, stopped eating crucian carp, and looked up in the direction of Li Qingshan.

The current distance is more than forty meters.

But the otter has obviously discovered itself. There is only one chance. If it fails and the otter dives into the stream and swims, the chance will be completely lost.

This moment.

Er Zhuang and Zhao Hongqi behind them clenched their fists tightly, with sweat even oozing out of their fists, looking nervously at the scene in front of them.

"Whoosh!"

Li Qingshan's hunting bow was full of moonlight, and the long arrow shot out instantly, at an extremely fast speed. The otter only saw a black shadow flying towards him. Just as he reacted and was about to run away, he felt his eyes go dark, and the long arrow sank into his head and neck.

The bright red blood quickly dyed the stream red, and the fat body kept struggling in the stream. Dahuang rushed out first, followed closely by Li Qingshan. When he lifted the otter out of the water, he was already motionless.

"Knife!"

After Li Qingshan finished speaking, Er Zhuang immediately handed the hatchet in his hand to Li Qingshan.

"Otter skin is relatively precious. It can be said that the meat of this body is not as expensive as this half of the skin. If you hunt an otter again in the future, you must be more careful when processing the fur. For example, the knife cannot be too sharp and must be blunt. Because a knife that is too sharp will damage the fur. If you accidentally poke a hole, the price will be directly reduced by a quarter or even a third."

"Also, the blood of the caught otter must be controlled as soon as possible, and the blood must not be stained on the fur. Just like fur, you have to hold the hind legs of the otter and perform an incision. The fur on the four paws and even the fur on the head must be preserved. Although the fur on the head will not be used during post-production, it must be preserved."

As Li Qingshan spoke, he carefully handled the hatchet in his hand, making a rustling sound from time to time as the hatchet cut across the flesh.

The newly dead otter still had some warmth, but it was very fat, indicating that this stream had good fishing resources. The fat was extremely sticky and greasy, so Li Qingshan carefully separated it.

Zhao Hongqi and Er Zhuang looked on and nodded.
